caption: Fix #1136: a disengaging unit's regiment position now anchors on its real contact-resisted front ranks. Infantry 1 gets a plain move order straight through the held Infantry 2 -- Infantry 1 never fights back (it takes real one-sided casualties from Infantry 2 defending its ground, identically before and after this fix; only the geometry changes). Before this fix, Infantry 1's own kinematic anchor kept climbing steadily toward the held line the whole clip. After it, the advance visibly arrests once contact begins, ending this clip roughly 20 world units short of where the unfixed advance reaches by the same tick.
